title: HAE-RAE Bench: Evaluation of Korean Knowledge in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models on the HAE-RAE Bench, a curated multiple-choice dataset testing Korean-specific cultural context, history, general knowledge, and linguistic nuances, to expose performance disparities between native Korean models and English-centric or multilingual models.

Analyzing statistical linguistic indicators, such as the probability of the longest or shortest multiple-choice options being the correct answer, to detect and remove superficial cues and formulation biases during dataset creation.
